metadata.description: Report civic issues to your municipality and follow them until they are fixed.

common.tagline: Report it. Track it. See it fixed.

citizen.headline: Tell your city what needs <accent>fixing</accent>.
citizen.intro: Potholes, overflowing bins, broken streetlights, blocked drains: report them to your municipality and follow each one until it's done.
citizen.signInToSeeTitle: Sign in to see your reports
citizen.signInToSeeBody: All you need is your mobile number. No password.
citizen.step1Body: Take a photo, drop a pin and choose what kind of problem it is.
citizen.step2Body: Your report reaches the department and ward responsible for it.
citizen.step3Body: Follow each update, and confirm when the work is actually done.
citizen.footer: CivicPulse never shows your name or phone number publicly.
citizen.reportHint: Takes about a minute. You'll need a photo and the location.

access.title: You don't have access to this page
access.body: You're signed in as {name}, and this account's role doesn't include this area. If you think it should, ask your municipal administrator.

field.title: My work orders
field.subtitle: Jobs assigned to you will appear here.
field.emptyBody: When a supervisor assigns you a job, you'll see the location, details and photos here.
field.offlineBody: Offline updates will be supported in a later release. For now, keep this page open on a connection.

notFound.title: We couldn't find that page
notFound.description: The link may be broken, or the page may have moved.

login.title: Sign in to CivicPulse
login.brandBody: One place to report what's broken in your neighbourhood and see who is fixing it.
login.brandPoint1: Sign in with just your mobile number
login.brandPoint2: Follow every report from submission to fix
login.brandPoint3: Your phone number is never shown publicly
login.phoneStepHint: We'll text you a 6-digit code. New numbers get a citizen account automatically.
login.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
login.attemptsRemaining: {count, plural, one {# attempt left.} other {# attempts left.}}
login.codeExpiredBody: Request a new code to continue.
login.codeLockedBody: This code can't be used any more. Request a new code to continue.
login.mfaStepHint: Staff accounts need a second step. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.mfaExpired: Two-step verification took too long. Start again with your mobile number.
login.mfaLocked: Too many wrong codes. Start again with your mobile number.
login.privacy: We use your number only to sign you in and send updates about your reports.

overview.title: Welcome back
overview.description: Triage citizen reports, keep categories up to date, and manage who works in CivicPulse.
overview.usersBody: Add staff, assign roles and departments, and deactivate accounts.
overview.auditBody: See who changed what, and when, with before and after values.
overview.issuesBody: Every reported issue in your area, with filters you can share as a link.
overview.mapBody: Issues on a map with ward boundaries, in sync with a list.
overview.categoriesBody: The kinds of problems citizens can report, their photo rules and extra questions.

users.title: Users
users.description: Staff and citizen accounts in this municipality. Staff need at least one role to work in the console.
users.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No users found} one {# user found} other {# users found}}
users.cantDeactivateSelf: You can't deactivate your own account.
users.createDescription: They'll sign in with this mobile number. Roles decide what they can see and do.
users.nameRequired: Enter a name with at least 2 characters.
users.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 10-digit mobile number starting with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
users.phoneTaken: Someone already uses this mobile number.
users.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
users.rolesHint: Limit a role to one department or ward, or leave both open for the whole municipality.
users.rolesHintNoScopes: Roles apply to the whole municipality. Department and ward scoping needs configuration access.
users.rolesDuplicate: The same role and scope is listed twice.
users.editRolesDescription: Saving replaces all of this user's roles.
users.deactivateBody: They won't be able to sign in until the account is activated again. Their history stays in the audit log.
users.activateBody: They'll be able to sign in again with their mobile number.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every sensitive change, who made it and what it looked like before and after. Times are shown in IST.
audit.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.

issues.title: Work queue
issues.description: Issues in your jurisdiction. Filters are kept in the address bar, so you can bookmark or share a view.
issues.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No issues match} one {# issue} other {# issues}}

filters.rangeInvalid: The end date is before the start date.

issueDetail.notFoundBody: It doesn't exist, or it's outside your jurisdiction.

statusDialog.title: Change status of {reference}
statusDialog.description: It's currently {status}. The change is recorded in the history and the audit log.
statusDialog.noTransitions: There are no status changes you can make from here.
statusDialog.reasonHelp: For staff only. Explain why, so colleagues and auditors can follow the decision.
statusDialog.publicNoteHelp: Shown on the citizen's report page. Don't include names, phone numbers or internal details.
statusDialog.conflictTitle: This issue changed while you were looking at it
statusDialog.conflictBody: Someone else updated it, so your change wasn't saved. Reload to see the latest version, then try again. What you typed is kept.
statusDialog.transitionGoneTitle: That change is no longer possible
statusDialog.transitionGoneBody: The issue's status may have moved on. Reload to see which changes are available now.

map.title: Issue map
map.description: Issues in the visible area. Pick a marker to find it in the list, or a row to find it on the map.
map.mapLabel: Map of issues. Markers can be reached with the Tab key.
map.truncatedBody: Only the first {count} issues in this area are on the map. Zoom in or narrow the filters to see the rest.
map.count: {count, plural, =0 {No issues} one {# issue} other {# issues}}
map.empty: No issues here. Move the map or change the filters.
map.noCityMap: This municipality has no boundary yet, so the map starts over all of India. Zoom in to your city to see its issues.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: What citizens can report. Each category sets how many photos are needed and which extra questions the report form asks.
categories.readOnly: You can view categories but not change them. Changes need configuration management access.
categories.activateBody: Citizens will be able to choose it on the report form again.
categories.deactivateBody: Citizens won't see it on the report form any more. Existing reports and issues keep it, and staff can still filter by it.
categories.dialogDescription: Changes apply to new reports straight away and are recorded in the audit log.
categories.codeHelp: A permanent identifier, such as pothole. Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
categories.codeLocked: The code can't be changed after the category is created.
categories.sortOrderHelp: Lower numbers appear first on the report form.
categories.activeOnCreate: Show on the report form straight away

errors.summary: Some details need fixing. Check the highlighted fields.
errors.code: Use 2–40 lowercase letters, numbers or underscores, starting with a letter.
errors.codeTaken: Another category already uses this code.
errors.nameEn: Enter an English name of at least 2 characters.
errors.photos: Enter a whole number from 0 to {max}.
errors.photoRange: The maximum can't be less than the minimum.

fields.title: Extra questions
fields.description: Asked on the report form after the citizen picks this category. Keep them few and quick to answer.
fields.empty: No extra questions. The report form will only ask for a description.
fields.keyHelp: How the answer is stored. Lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.

errors.key_format: Start with a letter; use only lowercase letters, numbers and underscores.
errors.key_duplicate: Another question already uses this key.
errors.option_value_duplicate: Each choice needs a different value.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.description: How CivicPulse addresses you and how we contact you.
profile.phoneHelp: Used to sign in. To change it, contact your municipality.
profile.nameRequired: Enter a name with at least 2 characters.
profile.emailHelp: Optional. Only used for updates you ask for; never shown publicly.
profile.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, or leave it empty.
profile.languageHelp: Used for this site and for SMS updates about your reports.

session.offlineDescription: Check your connection. You can keep browsing, but signing in won't work until we're back online.

errors.network_error: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_response: The server sent something unexpected. Please try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.token_expired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.tenant_mismatch: This account belongs to a different municipality.
errors.not_found: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.conflict: This conflicts with an existing record.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.rate_limited_wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
errors.validation_error: Some details aren't valid. Check the form and try again.
errors.idempotency_key_reused: This request was already sent with different details. Close the form and start again.
errors.invalid_code: That code isn't right. Check the message and try again.
errors.code_expired: That code has expired. Request a new one.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Request a new code.
errors.account_disabled: This account has been deactivated. Contact your municipality if you think this is a mistake.
errors.platform_account: This number belongs to a platform administrator, who can't sign in to a municipality here.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.service_unavailable: CivicPulse is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a minute.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.unsupported_media_type: This file type isn't supported. Use a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
errors.file_too_large: This photo is too large to upload, even after compressing it. Try another photo.
errors.too_many_uploads: Too many photos are still waiting to be sent. Remove some, or wait a few minutes, then try again.
errors.upload_verification_failed: The photo didn't arrive intact. Try uploading it again.
errors.upload_failed: The upload was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
errors.out_of_jurisdiction: This location is outside the municipality's area.
errors.evidence_required: This category needs a different number of photos.
errors.invalid_media: One of the photos can no longer be attached. Remove it and add it again.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else changed this while you were looking at it. Reload to see the latest version.
errors.invalid_transition: That status change isn't allowed from the current status.

report.title: Report an issue
report.resumed: We've kept the report you started earlier.

photos.title: Add photos of the problem
photos.hint: A clear photo helps the team find and fix it faster. You can add up to {max}.
photos.empty: No photos yet. Take one now or pick one from your gallery.
photos.tooFew: Add at least {min, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}} to continue.
photos.tooMany: Remove {extra, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}: you can add up to {max}.
photos.limitReached: You've added the most photos allowed ({max}).
photos.skipped: {count, plural, one {# photo wasn't} other {# photos weren't}} added: you can add up to {max}.
photos.tip: Tip: step back a little so the surroundings show too. It helps the team find the spot.

location.title: Where is the problem?
location.consentBody: We use your phone's location only to place this report on the map and send it to the right ward. It's never shown publicly with your name.
location.denied: Location access is turned off, so place the pin on the map instead. To use your location, allow it for this site in your browser settings.
location.unavailable: We couldn't get your location. Place the pin on the map instead.
location.unsupported: This browser can't share your location. Place the pin on the map instead.
location.mapLabel: Map. Drag the pin, or tap the map, to mark the spot.
location.mapHelp: Drag the pin or tap the map to mark the exact spot.
location.tapToPlace: Tap the map where the problem is.
location.noAddress: No street address found here. That's fine: the pin is what counts.
location.lookupFailed: We couldn't check this spot right now. You can still continue.
location.outside: This spot is outside the area {city} looks after. Move the pin inside the city to continue.
location.outsideGeneric: This spot is outside the municipality's area. Move the pin inside the city to continue.
location.lowAccuracy: Your location is only accurate to ±{meters} m. Check the pin is on the right spot, and drag it if it isn't.
location.confirmAccuracy: The pin is in the right place
location.missing: Mark the location on the map to continue.
location.checking: One moment: we're still checking this location.
location.confirm_accuracy: Confirm the pin is in the right place to continue.
location.noCityMap: Your municipality hasn't set up its map area yet, so the map starts zoomed out over India. Use your location, or zoom in to place the pin.

details.title: What kind of problem is it?
details.categoryRequired: Choose the kind of problem to continue.
details.categoriesError: We couldn't load the list of problems.
details.descriptionHint: What is it and how bad is it? For example: "Deep pothole by the bus stop, bikes are swerving round it."
details.descriptionTooShort: Without a photo, describe the problem in at least {min} characters.
details.photosTooFew: {category} needs at least {min, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}. You've added {count}.
details.photosTooMany: {category} allows up to {max, plural, one {# photo} other {# photos}}. You've added {count}.
details.suggestionLoading: Looking at your photo to suggest a category…
details.suggestionYourChoice: It's your choice: pick another one if this isn't right.
details.notCivicTitle: We couldn't spot a civic problem in this photo
details.notCivicBody: You can still continue. If it isn't the photo you meant to send, you can change it.

review.title: Check and send
review.hint: Check everything is right. You can't change a report once it's sent.
review.waitingUploads: Waiting for your photos to finish uploading…
review.uploadsFailed: Some photos didn't upload. Go back to the photos to try again or remove them.

submitErrors.network: We couldn't reach CivicPulse. Your report is saved on this phone: check your connection and try again. Sending it again won't create a duplicate.
submitErrors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Your report is saved, so try again in a moment. It won't be sent twice.
submitErrors.rate_limited: You've sent several reports in a short time. Wait a little, then try again.
submitErrors.rate_limited_wait: You've sent several reports in a short time. Try again in {seconds, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}.
submitErrors.out_of_jurisdiction: This location is outside the city's area, so the municipality can't act on it. Move the pin inside the city.
submitErrors.evidence_required: This kind of problem needs a different number of photos. Check the photos step.
submitErrors.invalid_media: One or more photos couldn't be attached; they may have expired. Remove them and add them again.
submitErrors.validation: Some details aren't valid. Check the details step.
submitErrors.idempotency_key_reused: It looks like this report was already sent with different details. Check your reports, or send this one as a new report.
submitErrors.signed_out: You've been signed out. Sign in again: your report is saved on this phone and will be here when you're back.
submitErrors.forbidden: This account can't send reports. Sign in with your citizen account.
submitErrors.unknown: Your report couldn't be sent. Try again.

done.title: Report sent. Thank you!
done.body: It's on its way to the team for {ward}. You can follow every update in My reports.
done.bodyNoWard: It's on its way to the municipality. You can follow every update in My reports.
done.referenceHelp: Quote this if you contact the municipality.

timeline.merged: Combined with another report of the same problem

reports.title: My reports
reports.description: Everything you've reported, newest first. Tap one to see its progress.
reports.emptyBody: Seen a pothole, an overflowing bin or a dark streetlight? Report it in about a minute and follow it here until it's fixed.

detail.notFoundBody: This report doesn't exist or belongs to another account.
detail.mapLabel: Map showing where the problem was reported
detail.noAddress: No street address; see the map.

matching.pendingBody: We're seeing whether someone has already reported this problem. It usually takes a few seconds.
matching.reviewTitle: A member of staff is checking for similar reports
matching.reviewBody: They're deciding whether this problem has already been reported. You'll see its issue here once they have.
matching.slowTitle: This is taking longer than usual
matching.slowBody: Your report is safe with us. Look in My reports again in a few minutes.
matching.linkedBody: {count, plural, one {# person has} other {# people have}} reported this problem. You'll see the same updates as everyone else.
matching.linkedBodyNoCount: Someone had already reported this problem. You'll see the same updates as everyone else.
matching.newBody: You're the first to report this problem.
